ops.title: Keep answered-pick deduplication from suppressing a rewritten PR card
ops.description:
Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali, implementation owner of this branch.
Evidence: cmd/cc-slack/prlinks.go:408-410 flags a replacement, but :436-438 can return a pick before reaching the new-card and replacement-record code at :450-471. livecards.go:719-727 pickOffering does not check whether the pick is open; card.go:750-759 offer identity contains PR, head, and options, without changed.
Failing case: draw a PR card with a head, add a matching pick, answer either so both close, then return the same waits/head/options with a newly added changed line. A tap_prs post chooses the answered pick, posts no fresh waiting card, and never marks the PR card replaced.
Next step: add this same-head answered-pick regression and ensure replacement candidates cannot be satisfied by an offer from the answered version.

ops.text: A new changed line on an answered PR card produces a fresh waiting card and marks its predecessor replaced even when a matching answered pick exists.
Unchanged held cards and current open matching picks retain their existing deduplication behavior; CI verifies both.
